subject: RE: Delivery Timeline — Very Concerned
body: Abhishek, we were expecting the API integration live by last Friday. This is the second delay and our board is asking questions. We need a concrete date by EOD today or we will escalate.

subject: API Scaling Issue — need your call
body: Hey, found a serious bottleneck in the payment gateway under load. Current architecture won't handle 200+ concurrent users. Opened a Jira ticket. Need 3 more days to refactor. This directly affects Client Alpha delivery.

subject: Pre-meeting checklist for Thursday
body: Looking forward to Thursday. Please bring updated revenue metrics deck, Q4 actuals vs projection, and 18-month roadmap. Our technical partner will join to review architecture.
